items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Tiny inline trend chart for stat cards / table cells / dashboard widgets. Line or area variant, optional tooltip, renders responsively into its parent. Built on Recharts.

items.name: metric-grid
items.title: MetricGrid (KPI row with comparison)
items.description: Responsive grid of KPI cards with built-in trend arrow + colour, comparison-vs-previous-period rendering, optional sparkline slot, optional icon, and loading-skeleton state.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker (dashboard presets)
items.description: Calendar-in-popover range picker tailored for dashboards. Bundles Today / Last 7 / Last 30 / Last 90 / This month / This quarter / YTD presets alongside a 2-month custom calendar.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: DonutChart
items.description: Donut/pie chart with built-in centre label slot, optional legend (with counts), and a theme-token-friendly default palette. Recharts-based.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: FunnelChart
items.description: Conversion funnel chart with auto per-stage percentage labels and tooltip showing % of previous and % of top. Recharts-based.

items.name: heatmap-calendar
items.title: HeatmapCalendar (GitHub-style activity grid)
items.description: Contribution-style heatmap with date-fns date math, configurable thresholds + cell size, per-cell tooltip, and an optional click handler. Use for activity feeds, deploys, commits, audit-log events, any 'did X happen today' signal.

items.name: chart-card
items.title: ChartCard (uniform dashboard widget shell)
items.description: Standard wrapper for every chart on a dashboard. Bundles title + description + optional actions dropdown + fullscreen toggle + loading skeleton + empty-state. Local `fullscreen` state expands the card to inset-4 while keeping slot DOM stable so chart libraries don't re-render from scratch.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: LineChart (themed Recharts)
items.description: Themed line chart with sensible defaults — muted gridlines, lightweight tooltip, theme-token palette, dashed comparison series support. Generic over the row shape so `series[].key` is type-safe. Pair with `<ChartCard>` for the shell + fullscreen + loading/empty states.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: BarChart (vertical / horizontal / stacked)
items.description: Themed bar chart. Vertical (default) or horizontal layout, grouped or stacked. Theme-token palette, optional rounded bar tops, axis tickFormatter slots. Generic over the row shape so `series[].key` is type-safe.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: AreaChart (gradient fill, stackable)
items.description: Themed area chart with a soft gradient fill — the dashboard staple for revenue / signups / traffic over time. Stacked or single, monotone / step / linear curve, theme-token palette, per-series colour override.
